title: Learning and Development: Tools and Strategies
overview: In today’s dynamic work environment, employees must continuously enhance their knowledge, skills, and abilities to stay effective and motivated. This places increasing pressure on learning and development (L&D) teams to deliver impactful training that aligns with strategic goals, performance needs, and emerging global trends. This course is designed to simplify the complexities of the L&D process and equip participants with practical tools and frameworks for designing and implementing comprehensive learning solutions.
audience: This course is tailored for learning and development professionals, including specialists, team leaders, and managers, as well as HR business partners. It also caters to those involved in shaping L&D strategy and designing tools and workflows to support the training function within their organization.
methodology: As an advanced program, the course focuses on workshops and reflective sessions, providing participants with hands-on experience. The aim is to equip attendees with new concepts and practical tools that they can immediately apply to enhance their L&D strategies and processes.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Classify organizational learning and development maturity models based on strategic directives
Design and select external training interventions using criteria like cost-benefit analysis
Create simple and effective learning frameworks to streamline the nomination process for line managers and employees
Distinguish between static and dynamic workflows and manage them according to operational needs
Implement a blended learning approach to develop individual growth plans for high-potential employees and successors
